servinfo.title: Adaptive cruise control at vehicle speed stored in memory cannot be resumed after adaptive cruise control was canceled by means other than CRUISE (main) switch

attention3.ptxt: Adaptive cruise control system is controlled by the RBS control module communicating with ESP® control module, BCM, ECM, TCM (A/T model), lighting and turn signal switch, dual sensor brake support control module and combination meter through CAN communication. Before performing symptom diagnosis, check that no DTC is indicated in these control modules.

condition.ptxt: Adaptive cruise control at vehicle speed stored in memory cannot be resumed after adaptive cruise control was canceled by means other than CRUISE (main) switch

ps.ptxt: Adaptive cruise control was canceled by means other than recoverable condition.
